name: aiida
description: Inspect, submit, and manage AiiDA calculations and workflows from your agent.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Python of the environment with AiiDA and aiida-mcp installed, e.g. /path/to/project/.venv/bin/python

profile.title: AiiDA profile
profile.description: Profile name, as listed by `verdi profile list`

aiida_path.title: AiiDA config directory (optional)
aiida_path.description: Only if your profile is not in ~/.aiida: the AIIDA_PATH that contains its .aiida folder

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide submit, kill, pause, and play; the agent can only inspect
